headline: Esther RANTZEN 🗣️ Too FRAGILE 🦵 to FLY ✈️ for SWISS 💉 END
text:
DAME 🏅 Esther Rantzen 🗣️ has DROPPED 💣 the BOMBSHELL 🧨 that she's now way too PHYSICALLY 🦴 fragile to TRAVEL ✈️ all the way to SWITZERLAND 🏔️ just to END 🪦 her life at an ASSISTED 💊 suicide CLINIC 🏥!! The veteran BROADCASTER 📻 who's a whopping EIGHTY 🕯️ SIX 🕯️ years old said she would have had to FLY ✈️ there completely ALONE 🙇‍♀️ which she could only pull OFF 🏁 before her life turned totally UNBEARABLE 😣 and way before she was truly READY 🕒 to call it QUITS 🛑!! The CHILDLINE 📞 founder who is now TERMINALLY ☠️ ill with CANCER 🎗️ first SPILLED 🗣️ the tea back in DECEMBER ❄️ 2023 that she had JOINED 🤝 the DIGNITAS 🏠 clinic and now she's using her latest STATEMENT 📜 on THURSDAY 📅 to BEG 🙏 MPs to finally VOTE 🗳️ yes on legalising ASSISTED 💉 dying in ENGLAND 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 and WALES 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 when the bill gets REVISITED 🔄 by Parliament on FRIDAY 📆!!

She ANNOUNCED 📢 that she had signed up for DIGNITAS 🏠 roughly a full YEAR 📅 after getting diagnosed with STAGE 🏟️ FOUR 4️⃣ lung CANCER 🎗️ and in her own WORDS 🗣️ unfortunately when she was still STRONG 💪 enough to actually make that FLIGHT ✈️ and reach DIGNITAS 🏠 her life was not yet UNBEARABLY 😣 painful in fact she was still able to just RELAX 🛋️ in her BELOVED 🥰 cottage in the NEW 🌳 FOREST 🌲!! And by the time her life finally became truly UNBEARABLE 😣 she had grown far too PHYSICALLY 🦴 fragile to survive making that JOURNEY 🛤️ and going through the whole DIGNITAS 🏠 process so even though she had already SPENT 💸 the money and made all the PLANS 📋 she was simply not READY 🕒 to end her life back then and never realised that would end up being her very LAST ⏰ chance!!

Dame Esther then ADDED ➕ that everything she absolutely DIDN'T 🚫 want to happen is exactly what she's FORCED 😩 to go through right NOW ⏰ with her loved ones either totally UNABLE 🙅‍♀️ to visit her at all or when they do they can't bear to actually SEE 👀 her suffering all that PAIN 😣 or total INDIGNITY 🚽!! The prominent ASSISTED 💉 dying CAMPAIGNER 📣 described the current LAW ⚖️ as super MESSY 🧹 and downright CRUEL 😢 saying it simply MUST 🔨 change and it has to change super QUICKLY ⚡ before more people get STUCK 🪤 in the same nightmare!!

Helping someone END 🪦 their life is still considered a straight up CRIMINAL 🚔 offence right across ENGLAND 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 SCOTLAND 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 WALES 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 and NORTHERN ☘️ IRELAND 🍀 while JERSEY 🏝️ only just legalised assisted dying for terminally ill ADULTS 🧑 earlier this very YEAR 📅!! MPs are currently chewing over a DRAFT 📝 law that if it finally PASSES ✅ would make the whole thing LEGAL ⚖️ in England and Wales under very SPECIFIC 📍 circumstances for people who are terminally ill with less than SIX 6️⃣ months left to LIVE 🫀!!

While Dame Esther who is best known for fronting the BBC 📺 programme That's Life for a whopping TWENTY-ONE 2️⃣1️⃣ years is one of several big names fully IN FAVOUR 👍 of the bill there are also plenty of campaigners lined up AGAINST ❌ it including the PARALYMPIAN 🏅 Baroness Grey-Thompson who fear any law CHANGE 🔄 could end up PRESSURING 😠 disabled and other vulnerable people to end their lives while also SLAMMING 🛠️ the wording of the proposed legislation for not having strong enough SAFEGUARDS 🛡️!! The bill has already been through several different DRAFTS 📝 and has been poked and prodded by multiple Parliamentary COMMITTEES 🧐 and even the HOUSE 🏛️ of Lords which chucked in a crazy ONE-THOUSAND TWO-HUNDRED 1️⃣2️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ amendments!!

The bill was first INTRODUCED 📥 back in 2024 but the last session of Parliament straight up RAN 🏃‍♂️ out of time before it could get PASSED ✅ it was then reintroduced in this fresh Parliament and a second VOTE 🗳️ is now locked in for Friday afternoon if it squeaks through the House of Commons then rarely used POWERS 💪 could kick in meaning it wouldn't even need the Lords assent to become LAW ⚖️ this time around and the proponents have already promised they will drag the legislation back in as soon as HUMANLY 🧍 possible if it gets voted DOWN 👎 on Friday!! Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said he will NOT 🚫 be voting on the issue at all and has suggested that palliative and social CARE 🏥 should be way better FUNDED 💰 before anyone even thinks about legalising assisted suicide!!
